ox.vision.analyze.description: Analyze one image with on-device OCR and classification: `await ox.vision.analyze({ purpose, source })`. Source may be a conversation or shared Profile-relative image path, or a file under `files/<folder-id>/` when Files is attached and the user has selected that folder. Image pixels stay on device; print only the returned text, dimensions, or labels needed for the task. Use `ox.fs.attach` when the model needs original pixels.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

source.description: Conversation or shared Profile-relative image path, or files/<folder-id>/<image> inside a selected folder.
